issue_context.title: The execution plan performance is inconsistent in prepare and non-prepare modes, under different collation
issue_context.body: ## Bug Report Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks! ### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required) ``` ### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required) Consistent execution plan when using hint ### 3. What did you see instead (Required) ### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required) MySQL [test]> SELECT tidb_version(); +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | tidb_version() | +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | Release Version: v6.0.0-8-g9258e39-dirty Edition: Community Git Commit Hash: 9258e39482be50fce59758ccb9ed0a03c010b225 Git Branch: release-6.0 UTC Build Time: 2022-06-05 08:54:27 GoVersion: go1.18 Race Enabled: false TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306 Check Table Before Drop: false
comments:
https://docs.pingcap.com/zh/tidb/v6.0/character-set-and-collation#%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E5%99%A8%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%BA%93%E8%A1%A8%E5%88%97%E5%AD%97%E7%AC%A6%E4%B8%B2%E7%9A%84%E5%AD%97%E7%AC%A6%E9%9B%86%E5%92%8C%E6%8E%92%E5%BA%8F%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99%E7%9A%84%E4%BC%98%E5%85%88%E7%BA%A7
根据官网，设置的连接级别的collation优先级低于行，改变连接级别的collation不应该会导致执行计划的变动

There is a warning:

`Optimizer Hint /*+ INL_JOIN(a, b) */ or /*+ TIDB_HINL(a, b) */ is inapplicable without column equal ON condition`

It says the optimize hint `INL_JOIN` is not inapplicable, that's why the plan changes.

From the code point of view, INL_JOIN cannot be completed due to collation changes.
But from the collation priority, user-level collation should not affect the execution plan.
So I suspect there is something wrong with this code

OK, I agree...
The collation **should not** prevent the index lookup join and make the plan change.

review_comments:
Could you describe you function detailly to help the one review or maintain you code quickly.
You can describe it step by step
Why this is a `hash join` instead of `index join`?
The optimizer cannot build an index join
hrad code seems not good, and here are a few branches, I think you you explain you function detailly

Modify the expression may cause two problems:
1. data race
2. some place may referencing the expression and find  it's unexpectedly modified ... this kind is difficult to debug

"X eq Y" and after the expression execution, they are modified ... this is a footgun, you're playing with fire.
Because you're joining t9 and t11
When create table collation is `_bin`, and the session collate is `_general_ci`, `INL_JOIN` join hint can't work?
In scenarios where pushdown is possible, hash join will be used
do you have a test case cover these branchs
If this function is not used outside the `expression` package, please use lowercase for the function name.
